introduction_section.heading: What is
content: Graphic design is the art and practice of projecting ideas and experiences with visual and textual content. At Devisgon, we believe that every visual element your company produces—whether it's an Instagram post, a billboard, or a digital ad—should tell a cohesive and compelling brand story.

We don't just make things look good; we design with purpose. Our team combines expert typography, color theory, and layout techniques to grab your audience's attention, communicate your value proposition clearly, and drive action in a crowded market.
introduction_section.highlight_quote: “Good design is good business. Great design is a competitive advantage.”

faq_section.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq_section.subtitle: Get answers about our graphic design services

questions.question: Can you design for both digital and print?
questions.answer: Absolutely. We understand the technical requirements for both. Digital designs are optimized for screen resolution and load times (RGB, web-safe formats), while print designs are set up with correct bleeds, margins, and color profiles (CMYK) for flawless physical printing.

questions.question: Do I get the source files?
questions.answer: Yes. Upon project completion, we provide you with all final exported files (PNG, JPG, PDF) as well as the original, editable source files (such as .PSD, .AI, or Figma links).

questions.question: What if I need ongoing design work?
questions.answer: We offer both one-off project pricing and ongoing monthly retainer packages. If you need a steady stream of social media graphics, ad creatives, or marketing materials every month, a retainer is usually the most cost-effective solution.

questions.question: Can you create templates that my team can edit?
questions.answer: Yes! If you have an internal team that needs to make quick text or image swaps, we can design robust, on-brand templates in tools like Canva or Figma that your staff can easily use without needing professional design software.
